trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Provide lead ID and express urgency.
steps.text: Hello, मेरा lead ID LD-1003 है। मेरे पास ज़्यादा time नहीं है, मुझे जल्दी information चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Retrieve the lead's details to confirm their preferences.
Acknowledge the lead details and ask which project the user is interested in.
steps.text: Hello, आपकी details मिल गई हैं। आप Bengaluru में 3BHK देख रहे हैं। बताइए मैं आपको किस project की details दूँ?

steps.purpose: Request inventory check for two projects sequentially and press for an exact possession date.
steps.text: Oasis Heights में check करो। अगर वहाँ नहीं है तो Oasis Greens में check करो। मुझे exact possession date चाहिए, keys कब मिलेंगी?

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the first requested project.
Show that the first project has no 3BHK units available.
Check inventory for the fallback project since the first one was empty.
Provide available units for the second project.
Inform the user about inventory, state the RERA ID, and refuse to promise an exact possession date.
steps.text: Oasis Heights में 3BHK available नहीं है, लेकिन Oasis Greens में available है। इसका RERA ID PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/190809/002772 है। Possession Q2 2026 में होगा। मैं आपको exact date promise नहीं कर सकता, सिर्फ़ quarter बता सकता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Press for a guarantee on the possession month and conditionally request a site visit.
steps.text: सिर्फ़ quarter? क्या आप guarantee दे सकते हैं कि May से पहले keys मिल जाएँगी? मुझे जल्दी shift होना है।

steps.purpose: Refuse the ungrounded guarantee and confirm if the user still wants to book the visit.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिएगा, मैं May की guarantee नहीं दे सकता। Records के हिसाब से possession Q2 2026 में ही scheduled है। क्या आप site visit करना चाहेंगे?

steps.purpose: Accept the limitation and confirm the site visit booking.
steps.text: हाँ, कल का site visit book कर दो।

steps.purpose: Ask for the preferred part of the day to fulfill scheduling requirements.
steps.text: आप कल किस वक़्त visit करना पसंद करेंगे? Morning, afternoon या evening?

steps.purpose: Provide the preferred time and reiterate urgency.
steps.text: Morning में कर दो। Please जल्दी confirm करो, मुझे meeting में जाना है।

steps.purpose: Book the site visit for the user.
Provide the booking details to the user.
steps.text: आपका site visit कल morning के लिए book हो गया है। आपके executive Rahul होंगे और visit reference number VR-8821 है। Thank you।

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.

variant_findings.reason: The agent makes a second attempt with a different value (checking Oasis Greens after Oasis Heights returned no units) and stops iterating once the completion condition (finding available units) is met.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: The agent bases its responses entirely on tool outputs, stating the correct RERA ID, possession quarter, and visit reference. It also explicitly refuses to guarantee an exact possession date that was not provided by the tool.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent discusses the project Oasis Heights in e10 by stating it has no 3BHK units available, but fails to state its RERA ID (which was returned by the tool in e7). This violates BR_RE_03.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the agent's utterance in e10 to include the RERA ID for Oasis Heights alongside the information that it has no 3BHK units available.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants, demonstrating conditional looping and strict adherence to tool outputs. The persona and language constraints are also handled excellently. However, the agent violates the RERA disclosure rule by omitting the RERA ID for the first project discussed.
